findings.evidence: grep hit: line 108 `Holomorphicity transfers...`; lines 111-113 state `DifferentiableOn ℂ ... {z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.im}`.

findings.issue: The docstring says holomorphicity transfers on the closed upper half-plane, but the theorem only states `DifferentiableOn ℂ ... {z | 0 ≤ z.im}`, a within-set differentiability statement on a non-open set.

findings.evidence: grep hit: line 135 `Holomorphicity transfers...`; lines 138-140 state only `DifferentiableOn ℂ ... (S ∩ {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im})`.
findings.fix: Describe the result as transfer of `DifferentiableOn` on the open-upper intersection, or require/document an openness assumption elsewhere.

summary: The added API is documented, but several docstrings overstate `DifferentiableOn` results as ordinary holomorphicity on non-open or arbitrary sets.
